name: event-sourcing-testbed
postStartCommand: echo 'Building testbed binary...' && cd /workspace/rust-app && cargo build --bin testbed 2>&1 | tail -5 && mkdir -p /tmp/cargo-target/release && ln -sf /tmp/cargo-target/debug/testbed /tmp/cargo-target/release/testbed && echo 'Ready — all services up, testbed binary built. Run: testbed kurrentdb-bench, bash tests/06-rehydration-replay-test.sh, etc.'
